subtitle: Amapuzzle amathente nezihlahla
short_description: Beka amathente, linganisa amasamba emigqa, bese ugwema ukuthintana.
description: Beka ithente elilodwa eduze kwesihlahla ngasinye, ugcwalise wonke amasamba emigqa nekholomu, bese uvimbela amathente ukuthintana, ngisho nangokuchezuka. Xazulula amabhodi amasha angu-8 e-5×5 nowe-6×6 anesixazululo esisodwa kuphela. Maka utshani, hlehlisa, qala kabusha, futhi ugcine inqubekelaphambili yakho kule divayisi. Akukho sibali-sikhathi noma ukwehliswa kwamaphoyinti.
